items.title: Two workers killed as earth collapses during road work in Baglung
items.blurb: Three workers were buried while building a road in Nisikhola, days after a landslide killed five people in the same area.

items.title: Journalist Kunda Dixit on a young, fragile Himalayas—and the risks Nepal is ignoring
items.blurb: Dixit, who has written about climate and environment for decades, says Nepal must rethink how it builds and plans for disasters in a rapidly changing mountain landscape.

items.title: Prioritise economic recovery and job accessibility for flood-affected communities
items.blurb: While disasters require immediate rescue and relief, enabling flood survivors to access income opportunities is equally vital.

items.title: Haunted by grief, Gaza’s displaced still wait overseas for return
items.blurb: More than 100,000 Gazans who fled the war remain overseas, waiting for security and reconstruction before returning to an enclave still largely devastated.

items.title: Police shoot and arrest man suspected of abducting 10-year-old girl
items.blurb: The girl was rescued unharmed after nearly 40 hours, while the suspect was found hiding in a paddy field and shot in the leg when he resisted arrest.

items.title: Nisikhola flood-displaced move to relatives’ homes with resettlement uncertain
items.blurb: Over 300 residents face housing and educational crises in Baglung and Parbat following the late September flash floods and landslides along the Nisikhola and Kaligandaki rivers.
